name: Sqrxz 2
author: Retroguru
description_short: An extremely difficult jump'n'run sequel that demands a sharp mind and fast reflexes.
description_long: The sequel to Sqrxz brings 10 tricky and hard levels with hidden passages to discover, retro graphics, 11 chiptunes, a top-ten high-score table and an infinite continue mode for practising. High frustration is guaranteed.
